verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Recurly RevRec offers "multi-currency support" for revenue recognition, which loosely touches consolidated reporting. Nothing in the pack shows billing customers in their local currency or setting per-currency price points, and community notes on international gateways do not address currency pricing. Missing for 10: documented per-currency plan/add-on price points, local-currency invoicing, home-currency consolidated reporting/FX conversion details, independent corroboration.
